svg.aria-label: j501-agx-orin: A 3D-printable enclosure for the Seeed reServer J501 carrier and an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin.
svg.title: j501-agx-orin: A 3D-printable enclosure for the Seeed reServer J501 carrier and an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin.
svg.desc: The Rev 0.9 enclosure drawn from its real STEP files with hidden lines removed: the base is traced, the rear plate and front plate slide down into their channels, the side hatch slides in and the cover drops on. Drawn from mvalancy/j501-agx-orin at commit 240be82ec542.
